notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run was performed. The clone's environment is a legacy gym.Env that needs CoppeliaSim 4.2, the cart_pole.ttt scene and the platform remoteApi library (README.md:16-19,27; VREP_RemoteAPIs/sim.py:14-20); neither was installed and no simulator run was performed. The card's mock_strategy upstream-sim was therefore not available: fake.py is this package's pure Python stand-in for the discrete configuration used by examples/demo_cart_pole_learning.py:19, with placeholder displacement constants marked in fake.py; it was never compared with a running CoppeliaSim. The continuous action configuration is not served. The fidelity contract declares engine coppeliasim and level F1 with timestep 5 ms taken from CartPoleEnv.py:119-120; the binary scene's actual step, mass, inertia, friction, contact and actuator parameters were not read. The fake seeds Python's random.Random while upstream seeds numpy's generator, so one seed does not repeat the same trajectory on the two. Two warning groups are expected: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.index and seed twice). No G4 warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
